dict.string: Buddy hears only the sound of the video in front of you, never your microphone or a call, so it knows what the lecturer just said. It keeps the last 90 seconds in memory and nothing on disk.
Buddy hears you while you hold Control + Option, while it explains so you can cut in, and when you explain a topic back to it.
Buddy looks at your screen so it can explain what is there and draw on it.
Buddy turns what you say into text, as a backup to Deepgram or in its place when no Deepgram key is set.
